title: When phone in Airport mode with bluetooth enabled miaomiao connectivity is very unstable
symptom: When the phone is in airplane mode with Bluetooth enabled, xDrip+ consistently fails to read the miaomiao. It will only work if you refresh via Bluetooth scan and leave the app in the foreground. Disabling airplane mode resolves the connectivity problem.
cause: xDrip+ has built-in logic that checks if airplane mode is enabled and may not operate properly when airplane mode is on, even if Bluetooth is manually enabled.
fix: Use an ADB command to change the airplane_mode_radios setting so that airplane mode does not affect Bluetooth. The suggested command is: settings put global airplane_mode_radios cell,wimax. Additionally, ensure that after a reboot, you are not in airplane mode initially; enter airplane mode after being on cell, with Bluetooth still enabled.
evidence_quote: on my device I did an ADB session and used a couple of commands to make it so airplane mode doesn't affect bluetooth or wifi. This makes it so xdrip+ runs just fine while in airplane mode.
